queries_run: Coca-Cola China tariff OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: KO 10-K 列出新增、擴大或報復性關稅（含推高供應商採購成本的關稅）、進口許可要求等為可能衝擊獲利的風險；原料與包材價格受關稅、制裁、配額、貿易障礙影響
findings.excerpt: new, expanded or retaliatory tariffs, including tariffs that increase suppliers’ sourcing costs; import authorization requirements; and other restrictions on business activities, which have been or may be imposed or expanded as a result of political and economic instability, deterioration of economic relations between countries or otherwise, could impact our profitability.

findings.claim: KO 2025 年美國以外營運產生 288 億美元淨營收，且 10-K 將貿易爭端、關稅、制裁列為匯率波動來源
findings.excerpt: In 2025, we derived $28.8 billion of net operating revenues from operations outside the United States.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 KO 針對中國的特定關稅／出口管制／實體清單事件；鋁罐 232 關稅相關報導僅有線索，未讀到頁面原文。

clues.claim: 報導稱川普政府可能下調 232 鋼鋁關稅（自 25% 升至 50%），範圍可能含鋁罐；KO 非直接進口商，成本由裝瓶商吸收，並表示若關稅不撤將推動更多 PET 包裝
clues.source: AOL 文章 president trump plans roll back

clues.claim: KO CEO 稱鋁關稅若不調整，可能讓更多產品改用 PET 包裝
